answer: Rather than prove who you are, the network asks what you can still produce, on a seeded haven that changes every epoch. Attestation weight is discounted when the accounts vouching for you are the ones you vouch for, and kinship in the invite graph triggers the same discount. A closed jetty of sock puppets scores near the floor no matter how many keys it adds, because escaping the discount requires genuine third-party verification. Net effect on the atlas: identity count stops being leverage, and the only way to scale is to produce genuinely more independent reasoning. Seal 1hxem.
